title: Remove 'Doctor Suites' title from doctors page

requirements.text: Remove the 'Doctor Suites' title/heading text from the DoctorsPage component while preserving the rest of the page content including hero section, doctor portraits, and CTA buttons

quotes: remove the tittle of Doctor Suites

acceptanceCriteria: The 'Doctor Suites' title text is no longer visible on the doctors page
All other page elements (hero image, doctor portraits collage, CTA buttons) remain intact and functional
Page layout adjusts naturally without the title

nonGoals: Removing the entire doctors page or route
Changing the doctor portraits or images
Modifying the CTA buttons or their functionality
